failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: The answer named a related topic or property instead of the requested referent, or failed to satisfy the complete clue despite existing slot and evidence checks.

rejected_edits.content: For a person, match the name form and granularity cued by the question. Use a familiar or conventional short name when that is how the clue identifies the person; include middle initials, additional name parts, or a formal given name only when requested, cued, or needed to distinguish the person. Do not expand a name merely because context contains a fuller form. Preserve honorifics when the clue cues them or they are part of the established conventional name.
rejected_edits.target: For a person, use an explicitly supported full personal name rather than a familiar nickname when the full name is relevant, and preserve honorifics that are part of the context-supported conventional name, especially when the clue cues them.

rejected_edits.content: - Track the direction of title and name changes. If a clue says a title was changed from A to B but asks for the original or source title, return A, not the altered title B; return B only when the altered title is requested. Likewise, when a current entity is identified by a former name, give the current name when that is the requested referent rather than repeating the former alias.
rejected_edits.target: - When an ellipsis marks omitted words in a title or phrase, use context to recover and return the missing continuation. Prefer a completion that fits the whole fragment over a prominent work or entity that matches only a shorter substring.

rejected_edits.content: - For completion or compound clues, identify the requested answer unit before responding. If the prompt clearly asks for a missing component, return only that component; if it asks for a conventional full name or expression whose parts are split between a blank and supplied text, return the complete name or expression. Do not mechanically omit supplied components or mechanically repeat them.
rejected_edits.target: - For completion or compound clues, identify the missing shared component that makes the alternatives fit; do not repeat a clue-supplied component or return one full compound. For partial-name prompts, give only the requested unknown name part. Omit components already stated in the question unless they are needed for unambiguous identification.
